questions.question: How should I wrap the worker? The branch will remain on origin either way — this only affects local state.

options.label: Full teardown (Recommended)
options.description: Kill the :8766 static server, git worktree remove the worker tree, git branch -D the local branch. Origin branch preserved. Standard close-work end state.

options.label: Keep worktree + branch local
options.description: Skip teardown — leave the worktree and the local branch in place so the manager (or you) can inspect/iterate without re-checking out. Only kill the :8766 server.

options.label: Leave everything as-is
options.description: Skip teardown entirely (worktree, branch, and :8766 server all stay running). Closes the worker session but local state is untouched.
